info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' prItiH tuzwiH . ' mutprItiH pramado harzaH ' iti amaraH . evaM sati akarmakaH . yaTA - Pala - mUlAdinA hariH prIyate . hfzyati ityarTaH . yadA tu prItiH tarpaRaM , prIY  tarpaRe iti krEyAdikAt ktini prItiSabdanizpattiH, tadA tu sakarmakaH . prIyate = tarpayati ityarTaH . ' prIN prItO prIyateprIRAt prIRIte tarpaRe YitaH . aRO yO YittvasAPalyAt prIRayet prayate prayet ' (Slo. 19-20) iti devaH .

info.name: karmakatvam
info.note: 'prIti' Sabdasya atra arTadvayaM manyate - tuzwiH tarpaRam ca . etAByAm  'tuzwiH' asmin arTe ayaM DAtuH akarmakaH asti, 'tarpaRam' asmin arTe tu sakarmakaH asti .

examples: 'tAByaH sarvAH kalAH prAdAt pariprItA sarasvatI' (skanda pu0 kA0 4.67.42). pariprItA'tyantaM prasannA.

examples.text: pipriye na sa taTA yaTA yuvA.
